accepted_checks: contiguous ranges and final remainder are derived from expected_total and chunk_bytes
canonical names, missing chunks, wrong sizes, extra pattern files, and scan-visible symlinks are checked
output and manifest path equality, expected source-chunk conflicts, symlink targets, and directory targets are rejected
each chunk is independently stream-hashed during scan and assembly
published output is re-read for exact size and SHA256 before manifest publication
overwrite is refused by default and deterministic manifest generation is implemented
manifest-replace directory-fsync failure and independent best-effort rollback paths are covered
module has no gzip or tar container semantics

blocking_findings.title: force backup creation failure can delete pre-existing output or manifest
blocking_findings.evidence: backup_output and backup_manifest use None for both pre-existing-but-not-yet-backed-up and did-not-exist states; the common exception handler unconditionally passes them to _rollback_one, whose None branch unlinks the target
counterexamples: failure of the first _copy_backup causes rollback to unlink both original targets
success of the output backup followed by failure of the manifest backup restores output but unlinks the original manifest
required_fix: track existed_before, backup_ready, and published state independently for each target
on backup preparation failure leave both original targets untouched
delete a target during rollback only when it did not exist before and was actually published
add synthetic tests for first-backup failure and second-backup failure after the first succeeds

test_evidence.environment_limitation: pytest tmp_path could not access the sandbox default or workspace basetemp due Windows ACL; escalated retry was interrupted

claim_boundary: STOP_FIX_TRANSPORT_ASSEMBLER requires correction and independent rereview of the exact new bytes. It authorizes no commit of the current candidate, no real chunk access or assembly, no tar/gzip access, no formal preflight, and no GO_RUN.
